implementation.rationale: The raw schema3 collector already retained a quote request context, but the existing closed four-field adapter and bounded SPI did not consume that context or an independent expected request. This slice connects those existing components rather than creating a new production helper.

explicitSelection.expectedQuoteRequestContext: Exact input grammar of snapshotDynamicPlasmaQuoteRequestContext: requestContextVersion, expectedChainProfile, compiledSporkIds, quoteRequest.

implementation.newObservationGrammar: The collector raw schema3 observation, not a four-field projection or a preclaimed normalization receipt.
sequence: Snapshot the independently supplied declared expected request/profile/compiled-spork context with the existing snapshot function.
Normalize both raw endpoint observations against the expected digest with the existing schema3 normalizer.
Require DP_ACTIVE, schema3 and MATCHES_DECLARED_EXPECTED_REQUEST_CONTEXT before policy use.
Require policy.maxPriceChangePercent to equal the normalized declared plasmaVariables.MaxPriceChangePercent on each creation, selection and validation call.
Explicitly project frontiers only after profile/spork/endpoint/quote validation, retain the detached request context and all four RPC quote fields, then reuse the unchanged shared policy arithmetic.
Rebuild and compare the origin receipt under the current supplied policy/digests/context, then recheck current resource, price, frontier-age and original-selection constraints.
implementation.compatibility: Absent the additional selector, the existing four-field adapter and legacy three-field strategy contracts remain selected. Extra fields, unsupported/missing selectors, mixed raw schemas and mixed receipt versions refuse; no silent downgrade.
implementation.output: Only the original fusedPlasma/difficulty pair. The fusion-only TOTAL is retained separately and is never attached alongside recommended PoW.
importantLimits: Request equality is declared-DATA equality, not RPC authentication, authenticated issuance, signer state or payer/provider/policy authority.
The closed request grammar does not bind a full unsigned block: amount, token, nonce, and other intent/preparation fields are not established by this request digest.

Observed p is still declared synthetic RPC DATA in this qualification. Actual deployed runtime p, governance stability, runtime/source/genesis/spork identity and price movement during real preparation/work/signing/inclusion remain separate gates.
Receipts are self-checking DATA. Another coherent caller-supplied context and receipt can be constructed; freezing and hashes do not establish custody, durability or authority.
The SPI is not wired into the active buyer, SDK unsigned preparation, work producer, validator publication path or a default runtime selection.
This does not add independent expected-digest enforcement to the native HTTPS observation owner or qualify its socket/drain/physical-close behavior.
Expiry and failed matching grant no replacement, payment, signature, authority reset, or automatic retry.

qualification.historicalQualification: Earlier qualification result artifacts are not rewritten. The previously completed22 request-context cases are not rerun here. This explicit selection is not a current full-suite qualification of all historical source-pinned fixtures.

launchReview.caller: Reviewed fixed inline CommonJS node:test run API plus node:test/reporters and node:stream; no saved/installed operational helper.
launchReview.files: The16 exact source/package/fixture paths listed in sourcePins, with no directory-read expansion.
launchReview.joinedSuccessRule: Exit stays at a non-success sentinel until all42 exact top-level pass events, all42 TAP PASS names, a single42-case plan and all seven counters agree; source and reporter streams must both complete. Failures, cancellation, skipped/todo, unknown/duplicate names or unexpected nesting cannot count as passed.
launchReview.limitation: The timeout, Node permissions and observed process-group state are not a hard native lifetime/cancellation/cleanup guarantee or an OS/network sandbox. Pristine/captured intrinsics, native loader/test/stream/hash and OS behavior remain premises.
